task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Remove the FRONT_CRATE obstacle by picking it up and placing it on TEMP_ZONE, then pick the MEDICINE_BOTTLE and place it on MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR and is graspable
CAR is within interaction_distance of FRONT_CRATE to pick it directly
TEMP_ZONE is a valid location to place the removed obstacle
After placing FRONT_CRATE, CAR can navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE and then to MEDICAL_TABLE
